item.title: Fire crews respond to burning apartment in Salt Lake City; residents evacuated
item.description: Firefighters evacuated residents and put out a fire in a Salt Lake City apartment complex on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn says she had a ‘successful’ 3rd surgery on broken leg following crash at the Olympics
item.description: Lindsey Vonn says she had a “successful” third surgery on her broken left leg following her downhill crash at the Olympics. Vonn posted an update on Instagram that included photos of her giving a thumbs up sign in her hospital bed with a metal frame attached to her leg.

item.title: James Van Der Beek, the ‘Dawson’s Creek’ star who later mocked his own hunky persona, has died at 48
item.description: James Van Der Beek, best known as Dawson on "Dawson's Creek," has died at 48, according to a statement on his Instagram.

item.title: DCFS case workers lag in response to thousands of child abuse and neglect reports, audit finds
item.description: Utah's DCFS had a major oversight problem, and that's led to issues with the handling of thousands of child abuse and neglect reports, according to a new legislative audit.

item.title: Instagram chief says he does not believe people can get clinically addicted to social media
item.description: Adam Mosseri, the head of Meta’s Instagram, testified during a landmark social media trial in Los Angeles that he disagrees people can be addicted to social media platforms.

item.title: Surge of 130,000 US hires last month is a stark contrast to the weak hiring of 2025
item.description: U.S. employers added a surprisingly strong 130,000 hires last month, but government revisions cut 2024-2025 U.S. payrolls by hundreds of thousands.

item.title: Utah mother mourns son killed in West Valley City carbon monoxide case, urges more support for adults with disabilities
item.description: Wendy Rollins, the mother of one of three disabled adults who died in what police said was a carbon monoxide poisoning case in West Valley City, said she hopes her son’s legacy is not only remembered by the people who loved him, but also becomes a turning point for how Utah supports adults with profound disabilities.

item.title: BYU football player arrested on suspicion of rape in Washington County
item.description: According to a press release from the Washington County Attorney's Office, Parker Trent Kingston, 21, was charged with felony rape.

item.title: An argument for the dark: Layton streetlights impact night sky
item.description: The battle to have a streetlight modified outside a Layton man's home has led him to a deep passion for Utah’s night sky.

item.title: One person dead after fiery Eagle Mountain crash
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY — One person is dead after a serious crash in Eagle Mountain Wednesday afternoon.
